module comparator (output reg [2:0] result, input [15:0] X, Y, input clk);
always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (X[15] == Y[15]) begin
            if (X[14:10] == Y[14:10]) begin
                if (X[9:0] == Y[9:0]) begin
                    result = 3'b001;
                end else begin
                    result = (X[9:0] < Y[9:0]) ? 3'b010 : 3'b100;
                end

                result = (X[14:10] < Y[14:10]) ? 3'b010 : 3'b100;
            end

            result = (X[15] < Y[15]) ? 3'b010 : 3'b100;

module UARTTransmitter(
  input        clock,
               reset,
               io_valid,
  input  [7:0] io_bits,
  input        tick,
  output       io_ready,
               tx
);
reg [3:0] state;
  reg [7:0] data;
  reg       ready;
  always @(posedge clock) begin
    if (reset) begin
      state <= 4'b0000;
      data  <= 8'b00000000;
      ready <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      case (state)
        4'b0000: begin
          if (io_valid) begin
            data <= io_bits;
            state <= 4'b0001;
          end else begin
            state <= 4'b0000;
          end
        end
        4'b0001: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b0010;
          end
        end
        4'b0010: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b0011;
          end
        end
        4'b0011: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b0100;
          end
        end
        4'b0100: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b0101;
          end
        end
        4'b0101: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b0110;
          end
        end
        4'b0110: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b0111;
          end
        end
        4'b0111: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b1000;
          end
        end
        4'b1000: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b1001;
          end
        end
        4'b1001: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b1010;
          end
        end
        4'b1010: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b1011;
          end
        end
        4'b1011: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b1100;
          end
        end
        4'b1100: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b1101;
          end
        end
        4'b1101: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b1110;
          end
        end
        4'b1110: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b1111;
          end
        end
        4'b1111: begin
          if (tick) begin
            state <= 4'b0000;
            ready <= 1'b1;
          end
        end
        default: begin
          state <= 4'b0000;
          ready <= 1'b0;
        end
      endcase
    end
  end
  assign io_ready = ready;
  assign tx = data[0];
  always @(posedge clock) begin
    if (reset) begin
      data <= 8'b00000000;
    end else begin
      if (tick) begin
        data <= {data[6:0], 1'b0};
      end
    end
  end
endmodule
